events.evidence: A severe 7.0 magnitude earthquake strikes Haiti. Tsunami watches issued across the Caribbean
Google says it may end its operations in China as it is no longer willing to continue censoring its search results
A bomb blast damages the Mozdok – Makhachkala – Kazi Magomed pipeline in Russia's Republic of Dagestan, leaving eleven towns in the republic without gas supply

label.note: Haiti quake and Google-China dispute dominate; Russia pipeline blast adds risk.
